measured_defects.dual_build: No conflict. aiDirectiveTick/directiveTick run inside diploTick (main.js:9101, diplomacy.js:5597-5608) before the aiTurn loop (main.js:9116). Automation = 28 of 1639 paid AI orders (1.71%); blocked by mineral<400 (41.8%), queue busy (42.6%), alloy<300 (12.6%). Same colony same month 5, same building 1. Not a defect: aiTurn already applies the same aiEconomicOrder filter.
measured_defects.focus_flip: Monthly sanayi/arastir/tarim limit cycle around empire thresholds (FOCUS_COOLDOWN 30 days). Multipliers are linear in time: no switching cost. Oracle per-colony research allocation saves <=0.7% of min+ala income. Not a defect worth code.
measured_defects.capital_type_focus: Rule e.home===sys.id forces every home-system colony to yonetim. 4/8 seeds, 2 empires each from month 2. seed11 120 months: +605 etk vs sanayi -4392 min -1622 ala -3674 ene. Proven inefficiency, but the fix exposes weak empires to a generic focus chain that ignores non-lithoid industrial deficits.
measured_defects.replacement_churn: 331 AI demolitions in 8x120; 88 (27%) followed by rebuilding the demolished key (84 within 6 months); only 41% build the wanted building next. The replacement scorer values a foundry (-14.65 min, +11.63 ala, -3.2 ene per month) as net negative. Known since 96H.6 (C1/C2 rejected).

candidates.R: REJECTED: replacement must add more marginal value than it removes. Demolitions 331->229 but same-key rebuilds 88->85; techs 336->312, mineral stock 68k->86k (stockpiling).
candidates.B1: REJECTED: only the first live home-system colony keeps yonetim. Untriggered seeds byte-identical; triggered gains, but seed42 empire4 mineral trap: crisis months [3,45,9,57,57] vs control [1,0,0,2,2] (outside band).
candidates.M: REJECTED alone: e.inc.min<0 counts like the lithoid mineral crisis. Triggered 23/99/123; no effect outside the placebo bands.
candidates.BM: REJECTED: B1+M. 120 months good (canonical 8x120 techs 336->352, crisis months 14->11, deliveries 417->513) but seed42 empire4 240-month min/tuk crisis median 98 [1..129] vs control 1 [0..55].
candidates.BM2: REJECTED: B1 + any ene/min/ala/tuk deficit -> sanayi. Fixes seed42 but triggers everywhere; 8x120 crisis months 14->25, techs 336->328 (seed11 0->13 crisis months).
candidates.BM4: REJECTED: B1 + sanayi when aiEconomicOrder's own urgency criterion marks ene/min/ala/tuk urgent. Crisis equal or lower in 7/8 seeds at 120 (seed99 median 0->1), seed42 240 crisis fixed, several outputs above band. Fails trade protection: seed11 240 deliveries median 288->95 (mean -34%), seed7 120 median 104->52; seed404 world ships/power below band (end-of-horizon war, 3 effective worlds). Broad: changes every seed.
